_provenance.slice_reason: Only the paribhāṣās the resolver cites or defers to are vendored. Upstream publishes no licence file, so bulk data stays out of this repository (CONSTITUTION Art. 6); the work itself is classical and public domain, the digitisation is community curation.
_provenance.commentary_omitted: Nāgeśa's vyākhyā is not vendored — only the paribhāṣā text, which is what the engine cites.

apavada.note: A declared exception defeats the general rule it names.

para.note: Of rules of equal strength, the later in the Aṣṭādhyāyī wins.

nitya.note: A conflict that turns on nityatva is decided by the layers below and recorded as such — never silently (Art. 18).

antaranga.note: See also PŚ 52, 54 (luk and lyap defeat antaraṅga) and PŚ 66 (an apavāda already carita-artha elsewhere yields).

once_beaten.note: What has once been set aside stays set aside — the reason state.blocked_sutras persists for the rest of a derivation.
